title: gfc: a uniform command-line toolkit for common bioinformatics file-format conversions
description: genome-format-converters (gfc) is a Python command-line toolkit that exposes 30 bioinformatics file-format converters under a single uniform interface (gfc <subcommand>). Coverage spans annotation (GFF3, GTF, BED, BED12, GenBank), sequence (FASTA, FASTQ, QUAL, Stockholm), alignment/mapping (BAM, SAM, CRAM, MAF, MUMmer delta, BLAST outfmt 6, HMMER tblout), variant (VCF, BCF, EIGENSTRAT diploid and pseudohaploid, PLINK binary), orthology (OrthoFinder orthogroups), and phylogenetic tree formats. Ships with a full pytest suite, Linux/macOS/Windows CI, a reviewer-replayable benchmark harness, and a JOSS paper draft.
